summary: This bill amends Clean Air Act section 319(b) to expand the definition of exceptional events to include prescribed fires and similar state-approved actions to mitigate wildfire risk, requires EPA to revise its regulations within 18 months to allow exclusion of affected air quality data from regulatory determinations, and mandates regional modeling for multistate events plus a public petition-tracking website.

scores.thoughts: This bill modifies the Clean Air Act to allow states to exclude certain wildfire-related air pollution data from national ambient air quality standards (NAAQS) determinations. This change could lead to less stringent enforcement of air quality standards in areas affected by wildfires, which generally means less environmental protection.
